details:
This update for sssd fixes the following issues:

- CVE-2026-80048: sssd-kcm: local denial of service due to excessive memory preallocation (bsc#1284466).
- CVE-2026-88252: denial of service via responder connection retry loop during file descriptor exhaustion (bsc#1284465).
- CVE-2026-90462: fail-open in LDAP `ppolicy` access check allows continued authorization for deleted user
  (bsc#1282584).
- CVE-2026-90463: out-of-bounds read in the NSS service request parsers (bsc#1280360).
- CVE-2026-90994: out-of-bounds read in PAM v1 parser (bsc#1280361).
- CVE-2026-90995: NULL pointer dereference in PAM responder (bsc#1280362).
- CVE-2026-90996: zero-length request body underflow in the NSS responder (bsc#1280363).
- CVE-2026-92821: access control bypass due to premature LDAP access rule evaluation (bsc#1284326).
- CVE-2026-104029: denial of service due to out-of-bounds read in `autofs` responder (bsc#1284314).
- CVE-2026-104030: denial of service due to out-of-bounds read during passkey parsing (bsc#1284315).
- CVE-2026-104031: denial of service via memory exhaustion in `autofs` responder (bsc#1284316).
- CVE-2026-104032: denial of service via unprivileged autofs cache invalidation (bsc#1284317).
- CVE-2026-104033: access control bypass due to improper LDAP shadow expiration check (bsc#1284318).
- CVE-2026-104035: denial of service via memory exhaustion in KCM responder (bsc#1284320).
- CVE-2026-104036: denial of service due to out-of-bounds write in NFS `idmap` plugin (bsc#1284321).
- CVE-2026-104037: denial of service due to packet length underflow in `autofs` responder (bsc#1284322).
- CVE-2026-104038: denial of service via missing SID extension in certificate mapping (bsc#1284323).
- CVE-2026-104039: denial of service due to stale connection state reuse in PAM GSSAPI responder
  (bsc#1284324).
- CVE-2026-104041: denial of service via unbounded negative cache growth (bsc#1284254).
- CVE-2026-104042: denial of service via out-of-bounds read in PAM responder (bsc#1284265).
- CVE-2026-104043: denial of service via undersized packet parsing in NSS responder (bsc#1284266).
- CVE-2026-104044: denial of service via crafted passkey Kerberos authentication request (bsc#1284267).
- CVE-2026-104045: denial of service via race condition in `autofs` responder (bsc#1284470).
- CVE-2026-104048: authorization bypass via cross-domain username collision in HBAC evaluation (bsc#1284467).
